paragraphs: From Navan test centre on Metges Road, pull out and take your 1st left onto Johnstown
Follow it round take the sharp right back onto Metges Road
Continue to the junction with the R147 and turn right, then shortly after take the left to stay on the R147 heading out of town
After about 1.6km on the R147 turn right onto the L8010 and follow this country road
At the end turn right onto the Trim Road and continue for roughly 1.6km
Turn left onto Dan Shaw Road take your next left onto Claremount Avenue for a quiet residential stretch
Continue straight as Claremount Avenue becomes Clougherboy Park, then at the roundabout take the 1st exit onto Bóthar an Mhota
Further along you will meet the Andy Connolly Roundabout, where you take the 1st exit and continue straight as the road changes name back through Clougherboy Park and Claremount Avenue
Turn right onto Dan Shaw Road right into Beechmount Vale
Follow it as it becomes Beechmount Gardens take the right into Beechmount Court
Left onto Beechmount Crescent you will practice a turnabout on this quiet stretch before continuing back out via Beechmount Avenue
At the end of Beechmount Avenue turn right onto the Trim Road
Left to stay on the Trim Road heading back towards town
Turn left onto the L8010, right onto the R147
Left onto Metges Road along here you will practice a reverse around a corner using the side road off Metges Road
To finish, retrace your steps back onto Metges Road, out to the R147, along the L8010 and onto the Trim Road again
Turn left onto Dan Shaw Road and then left into the Beechmount Industrial Estate, where the examiner will guide you back to the Navan test centre
